title: Subagent UI polish, role iconography, display title sanitization, granular abort and anti-slop presentation
commitMessage: fix(subagents): remove native title tooltip on stop button per § 2.20
author: react-tailwind-artisan

sensors.cargo_check: pass (cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml, finished in 7.59s, 0 errors)
sensors.pnpm_build: pass (tsc && vite build, built in 6.20s, 0 errors)
sensors.l2_reviewer: APPROVED (initial return for § 2.20 title attribute in 884f52f resolved in 09cf2ad)

summary: Polished subagent UI/UX across drawer components: (1) replaced placeholder black square unicode glyphs (■) with typed Lucide role icons (Code2, ShieldCheck, Compass, Bot) via getRoleIcon; (2) sanitized technical internal sub-call IDs (sub-call_X) into humanized titles ('субагент') via formatSubagentDisplayTitle and removed redundant subagentId monospace pills; (3) eliminated raw JSON todos dumps in AgentExplanationCard via tryExtractTodos and proximity suppression with nearby todo_write tool calls, rendering clean tactile action checklists ('План действий') when standalone; (4) enabled granular subagent abort in AgentConsoleDrawer and SubagentsSidebar, allowing users to stop individual subagents without terminating the parent task or destroying uncommitted context; (5) purged unformatted ISO timestamps from tool execution card footers and removed native HTML title tooltip per § 2.20.

rootCauses.issue: Native HTML title attribute on stop button in SubagentsSidebar
rootCauses.explanation: Initial commit 884f52f added title="Остановить выполнение субагента" to the new subagent stop button. Caught by Level 2 Reviewer for violating § 2.20 (Native Browser Tooltip Ban on Labeled Controls). Fixed in commit 09cf2ad.

rootCauses.issue: Raw JSON todos and technical ID leakage
rootCauses.category: Inadequate Payload Structure Classification & UI Plumbing Leak
rootCauses.explanation: Intermediate commentary cards assumed all model output was markdown prose, blindly rendering JSON arrays. Engine plumbing (sub-call_X) was displayed raw due to missing title normalization.

rootCauses.issue: Crude Unicode Glyphs (■) in place of iconography
rootCauses.explanation: Unicode black squares placed during rapid prototyping were not connected to getRoleIcon() across DrawerHeader, DrawerActivityStream, and ToolExecutionCard.

rootCauses.issue: Coarse-grained abort destroying parent orchestrator context
rootCauses.explanation: The drawer only implemented root-level abort_agent(task.id), lacking granular targeting for active subagent sessions.
